label: Frame interval
help: time between camera frames; sets the time axis of the tensors
name: dt_frame_ms

label: Channel width
help: wall to wall in the imaged direction; calibrates um/px from the walls
name: channel_width_um

label: Channel height
help: the depth of the channel; the heated wall is below
name: channel_height_um

label: Flow rate
help: volumetric inlet flow rate
name: flow_rate_mL_hr

label: Wall heat flux
help: the series' wall flux, uniform over the heated wall: it heats the liquid where there is liquid and evaporates the film under the bubble
name: q_wall_W_cm2

label: Reference velocity
help: measured nose-speed scale; sets the reference time
name: U_ref

label: Inlet temperature
help: the liquid entering the channel; not set means saturation
name: T_inlet_C

label: Initial liquid temperature
help: the whole liquid before the first frame; its excess over saturation is the superheat scale
name: T_init_C

label: Initial thermal layer
help: the initial temperature holds only farther than this from the first frame's outline; inside it the heat equation forms the layer the bubble already has
name: T_init_layer_um

label: Side walls
help: adiabatic walls pass no heat; isothermal walls hold the wall temperature
name: side_wall_thermal

label: Side-wall temperature
help: read only when the side walls are isothermal
name: T_wall_C

label: Wet fraction
help: the wet share of the footprint the wall flux evaporates: fixed at the value below, or fitted as one bounded scalar that starts there
name: wet_fraction_mode

label: Wet fraction value
help: the share of the bubble's footprint still covered by liquid film; the fixed value, or the fit's start (strictly inside 0 and 1)
name: wet_fraction

label: Superheat scale
help: not set means the initial superheat when the initial temperature is given, else the conduction scale
name: dT_ref_K

label: Walls
help: the side walls at the crop edges, or at the detected wall rows (needs tensors preprocessed with wall positions)
name: walls_at

label: Wall condition
help: no slip holds the liquid still at the walls; no penetration only stops it crossing them
name: wall_condition

label: Momentum closure
help: Darcy drag alone, or Darcy with the Brinkman term that makes no slip admissible
name: momentum_closure

label: Outlet
help: nothing imposed at the downstream edge, or a zero gradient for a channel that continues past the field of view
name: outlet_condition

label: Pressure
help: one network for both phases, or the uniform vapour pressure inside the bubble and the liquid network outside, with the jump built in
name: pressure_representation

label: Thermal model
help: the legacy diffuse energy equation, or the liquid-only equation with the interface at saturation and the series' thermal conditions
name: thermal_model

label: Vapour source
help: a free source network pulled toward the evaporation flux, or the flux itself spread over the front
name: source_mode

label: Film evaporation under the bubble
help: the wall flux under the footprint evaporates the liquid film at the wet fraction and creates vapour there: the growth mechanism of confined boiling
name: footprint_evaporation

label: Mirror symmetry
help: build the symmetry about the channel centreline into every field; for after the physics passes its tests without it
name: mirror_symmetry

label: Interface temperature
help: saturation is conduction-limited evaporation; the kinetic route is not built under the sharp model yet
name: interface_temperature

label: Temperature parameterisation
help: gated multiplies the network by the distance into the liquid, so the front is exactly at saturation; free is not built yet
name: theta_parameterization

label: Temperature gate width
help: smoothing of the distance gate; keep well below the thermal layer
name: theta_gate_width

label: Temperature gate shape
help: linear multiplies the network by the distance into the liquid; saturating levels off beyond the thermal layer, so the far field does not move with the bubble
name: theta_gate

label: Temperature gate length
help: where the saturating gate levels off: about the thermal layer's thickness
name: theta_gate_length

label: Source kernel width
help: width of the band the front flux is spread over; not set means the interface half-thickness
name: source_kernel_width

label: Cross-section mass balance
help: the volume flux through every cross-section equals the inlet flux plus the vapour created upstream
name: mass_balance

label: Mass balance weight
help: weight of the mass balance term; it sits outside the rebalancer
name: mass_balance_weight

label: Collocation time bins
help: distinct instants per collocation batch; the thermal source needs at least one
name: collocation_time_bins

label: Causal convergence gate
help: the causal schedule tightens only once every time chunk's weight clears this; not set keeps the fixed annealing
name: causal_gate_min_weight

label: Log per-chunk residuals
help: record each equation's residual per time chunk, so a late time left unenforced is visible in the run's history
name: log_chunk_residuals

label: Physics weight cap
help: no rebalanced physics weight may exceed this multiple of the data weight; 0 keeps the fixed ceiling alone
name: rebalance_max_ratio

label: Gradient clip
help: bound on the total gradient norm per step; 0 is no clipping
name: grad_clip

label: Outline guard
help: measure the fit of the masks every this many steps after the warm-up and stop a run that has drifted; 0 is off
name: outline_guard_every

label: Outline guard drop
help: the mean IoU may fall at most this far below the warm-up's fit
name: outline_guard_drop

label: Freeze the outline after the warm-up
help: two-stage training: the bubble is fixed at the warm-up's fit of the images and the physics stage trains only the velocity, pressure and temperature
name: freeze_geometry

label: Weights after the freeze
help: once the outline is frozen: each physics term at its configured weight, or rebalanced to equal gradient contributions
name: frozen_weighting

label: One-way heat advection
help: the temperature equation trains the temperature only, so its error cannot bend the flow; the liquid carries the heat, the heat does not move the liquid
name: one_way_advection

label: Jitter the quadrature times
help: draw the front times and the mass-balance instants afresh each step instead of fixed grids, so the physics is scored across the window
name: quadrature_jitter

label: Mass balance stations
help: x-stations of the cumulative source integral
name: mass_balance_stations

label: Mass balance time slices
help: fixed time slices across the window
name: mass_balance_times

label: Mass balance quadrature
help: transverse quadrature points, wall to wall
name: mass_balance_grid

label: Acceptance audit
help: write the acceptance audit beside the metrics after evaluation
name: audit

label: Audit scan instants
help: instants across the whole event the residuals and the flux are scanned at; 0 skips
name: audit_scan_times

label: Seed agreement
help: minimum correlation of each hidden field across seeds
name: seed_corr_min

label: Mirror breaking
help: maximum symmetry-breaking fraction of a hidden field
name: mirror_max

label: Residual RMS
help: maximum RMS of any collocation residual on the audit grid
name: residual_rms_max

label: Flux balance
help: maximum cross-section flux defect, relative to the inlet flux
name: flux_tol

label: Heat budget
help: maximum spread between the latent-power estimates
name: heat_budget_tol

label: Outline floor
help: minimum IoU against the mask at every event frame
name: iou_min

label: Outline drop
help: how far below the warm-up's fit a frame's IoU may end
name: iou_drop_max

label: Nose tolerance
help: maximum distance between the predicted and the measured nose at any frame
name: nose_tol

label: Shape change the jump asks for
help: the Young-Laplace mismatch on the front as the shape change that would remove it; its 90th percentile may not exceed this many pixels
name: jump_px_max
